localCapabilities.supportedLinuxEditorInfrastructure: Ubuntu 22.04 or Ubuntu 24.04 workstation with supported graphics drivers and reviewed Unity entitlement
remainingUnityImplementation: Licensed Editor import, package resolution and reviewed packages-lock.json
C# compilation and actual EditMode/PlayMode runs
Linux player build and interactive graphics smoke
localCapabilities.windowsMonoCrossBuild: Conditional on installed Windows Build Support module and successful batch build

externalGates.requiredResource: Named physical Windows low, balanced and ultra tier PCs with recorded CPU, GPU, VRAM, RAM, SSD, OS and driver versions
procedure: Record device inventory and source/build hashes on each physical Windows PC
Run spawn-to-terminal, plaza traversal and activity routes with fixed quality, resolution and warm-up
Capture frame p95/p99, GPU time, VRAM, memory, thermal state and crashes against task budgets
externalGates.expectedEvidence: Device inventory, profiler captures, route timings and actual Windows gameplay recording tied to binary hash

externalGates.requiredResource: Installed pinned Linux Editor, reviewed developer/runner license entitlement and required build modules
procedure: Owner reviews applicable Unity terms and records entitlement for each person and runner
Authorized operator installs and activates the pinned Editor
Run node scripts/unity-validate.mjs tests and linux on supported Linux infrastructure
externalGates.expectedEvidence: Entitlement review reference, Editor/module inventory, resolved package lock, batch logs, NUnit XML and Linux player hash

externalGates.requiredResource: Reviewed Unity entitlement and Windows runner with C++ tools, Windows SDK and IL2CPP module
procedure: Build the exact reviewed source using the pinned Editor and Windows IL2CPP backend
Record toolchain/module versions and hash all player outputs
Launch the resulting build on a physical Windows qualification PC
externalGates.expectedEvidence: Build log, binary manifest, source revision and physical Windows runtime results

externalGates.requiredResource: Approved publisher identity, signing credentials and authorized signing operator
procedure: Sign the reviewed installer through the authorized signing process
Verify signature and publisher on a clean physical Windows PC
Install, launch and uninstall under a standard user account
externalGates.expectedEvidence: Signature verification output, publisher identity, installer hash and clean-machine installation record

externalGates.requiredResource: Physical Windows PCs, keyboard/controller hardware, signed test builds and safe update infrastructure
procedure: Exercise launch, focus loss, keyboard/controller input, graphics quality and crash recovery
Exercise disconnect, reconnect and policy revocation against the test backend
Interrupt an update, verify rollback and relaunch the previous known build
externalGates.expectedEvidence: Test cases, crash dumps, input/graphics recordings, update manifests and rollback hashes

externalGates.requiredResource: Original or licensed production artwork and responsible human art/rights reviewers
procedure: Review provenance, license scope and authoring/rig/material budgets for each production asset
Replace developer primitives through the asset review process
Capture approved media from the qualified physical Windows player with source/build hashes
externalGates.expectedEvidence: Asset rights manifest, human review references, art budget audit and approved gameplay capture provenance

externalGates.requiredResource: Explicit operational, security, legal and product approvals plus authorized production credentials
procedure: Review qualified build, privacy/safety, operational readiness and rollback evidence
Record explicit public rollout authorization
Execute the separately authorized release procedure
externalGates.expectedEvidence: Named approval references and authorized release/rollback record
